headline: Prices Fell to the 2% Range, Yet Rates Are Raised Again? The 'Real Number' the Bank of Korea Is Watching [Three-Minute Economics]
summary: July consumer price inflation fell to the 2% range for the first time in three months. The Bank of Korea is focusing on core inflation behind the headline figure rather than easing its guard.
why: The Bank of Korea sets the country's benchmark interest rate, and its inflation assessment shapes rate expectations for the won and Korean government bonds.
